To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
responsible research is research that fulfills standards of academic research and contributes, positively, to society.
responsible research is high quality academic research that contributes positively to peace.

(a) the concept of peace can be expanded to include the values of truth, freedom, justice, love and care, and beauty; (b) responsible research is research that fulfills standards of quality research and contributes to one or more of the expanded aspects of peace; and (c) responsible research can be used to address social problems and contribute to the development of a peaceful and just society.
In summary, our research is concerned with
peace, and we must conduct it in a responsible way.
a world that is more peaceful, more inclusive, more just, more sustainable, and more democratic.
the well-being of humanity.

responsible research is research that is of high quality and that contributes to the expansion of peace.
the standards of responsible research are the standards of high quality and peace.

responsible research is research that fulfills standards of quality research and, at least, one of the three following criteria: (i) it contributes to the reduction of the risk of war; (ii) it contributes to a reduction of the risk that war breaks out; (iii) it contributes to an enhancement of the quality of peace.

responsible research is high quality research with a positive contribution to peace.
responsible research contributes to peace.
we need to make our research responsible and, at the very least, contribute to the expansion of peace.

the concept of responsible and high quality research is a powerful tool for peacebuilding.
standards of high quality and responsible research are mutually reinforcing, and that responsible research is a call for peace.
